tagline.en: Miami to the Canadian border — the eastern seaboard's spine
tagline.zh: 从迈阿密直抵加拿大边境——美国东海岸的脊梁

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.zh: 佛罗里达州迈阿密，与 US 1 相接

end.zh: 缅因州霍尔顿，霍尔顿—伍德斯托克边境口岸

en: I-95 runs the full length of the Atlantic seaboard, from a set of ramps onto US 1 in Miami to a Customs booth at the Canadian border in Houlton, Maine. At 1,904.61 miles it is the longest north–south Interstate, and it touches fifteen states plus the District of Columbia — more jurisdictions than any other route in the system.

It is not one road so much as a chain of very different ones. In Florida and the Carolinas it is a wide, flat, fast rural freeway. From Washington to Boston it threads the densest urban corridor in the country and spends much of its length as an elevated, tunnelled, or tolled city expressway. North of Portland it empties out again and finishes as a two-lane-each-way road through the Maine woods, where the last 120 miles pass almost no one.
zh: I-95 纵贯整个大西洋沿岸，南端是迈阿密通往 US 1 的一组匝道，北端是缅因州霍尔顿的加拿大边境海关亭。全长 1,904.61 英里，是最长的南北向州际公路，途经 15 个州及哥伦比亚特区——经过的行政区数量为全系统之最。
与其说它是一条路，不如说是一串性格迥异的路。在佛罗里达和南北卡罗来纳，它是宽阔平坦、车速很快的乡村高速；从华盛顿到波士顿，它穿过全美最密集的城市走廊，大段路程以高架、隧道或收费城市快速路的形式存在；过了波特兰又重新空旷下来，最后变成双向各两车道，穿行于缅因州的林地，最后 120 英里几乎见不到人。

en: I-95 was laid out in the first numbering of the Interstate System in 1957, and much of it was built by absorbing toll roads that already existed along the same line — the New Jersey Turnpike, the Connecticut Turnpike, parts of the Maine Turnpike. That is why the route feels older than its 1956 charter in places: some of the pavement predates the system it belongs to.

For thirty-five years it was famously unfinished. New Jersey cancelled the Somerset Freeway in 1983 after sustained local opposition, which left I-95 with no through alignment across the middle of the state. Northbound drivers reached US 1 near Trenton and had to leave the Interstate, follow I-295 and I-195 for about sixteen miles, and rejoin the number on the New Jersey Turnpike.

The fix was an interchange where I-95 crosses the Pennsylvania Turnpike at Bristol Township, in Bucks County. Its first ramps opened on 22 September 2018, I-95 was rerouted onto the Turnpike and the Turnpike's Delaware River bridge, and the orphaned Trenton section became an extension of I-295. Sixty-one years after it was numbered, the road finally ran from Miami to Maine without interruption.
zh: I-95 在 1957 年州际公路系统首次编号时即已划定，其中很大一部分是把沿同一走向早已存在的收费公路并入而成——新泽西收费高速、康涅狄格收费高速、缅因收费高速的一部分。这也是为什么它在某些路段显得比 1956 年的立法还要老：有些路面比它所属的系统更早。
它有三十五年时间以「未完工」闻名。在持续的地方反对之下，新泽西州于 1983 年取消了萨默塞特高速公路计划，I-95 因此在该州中部没有了贯通线位。北行的司机开到特伦顿附近的 US 1 就必须离开州际公路，沿 I-295 与 I-195 行驶约十六英里，再回到新泽西收费高速上的 I-95。
解决办法是在宾夕法尼亚州巴克斯县布里斯托尔镇、I-95 与宾州收费高速交汇处修建一座互通立交。首批匝道于 2018 年 9 月 22 日通车，I-95 改走收费高速及其特拉华河大桥，原先那段孤立的特伦顿路段则并入 I-295。在编号六十一年之后，这条路终于能从迈阿密不间断地开到缅因。

en: There is no published construction cost for I-95 as a whole, and there could not honestly be one. It was assembled over six decades by sixteen separate jurisdictions, partly out of turnpikes that were financed with bonds and repaid at the toll booth long before the Interstate programme existed. Federal cost records were kept for the system, not per route.

Individual pieces are well documented, and those figures are worth more than a made-up total. The last gap, the Pennsylvania Turnpike interchange, is the clearest example: a single connection between two roads that already existed, costing several hundred million dollars and taking fourteen years from the start of design to the opening of its first ramps.
zh: I-95 整条路并没有公开的总造价，而且老实说也不可能有。它由十六个行政辖区历经六十年拼接而成，其中一部分原本是发行债券修建、在州际公路计划出现之前就已靠收费偿还的收费公路。联邦的造价记录是按系统统计的，不是按路线统计的。
单个工程倒是有翔实记录，这些数字比一个拼凑出来的总数更有价值。最后那处缺口——宾州收费高速互通立交——就是最清楚的例子：仅仅是把两条既有道路连起来，造价数亿美元，从设计启动到首批匝道通车用了十四年。

why.en: No public figure exists. The route was built piecemeal by 15 states and the District of Columbia between the 1950s and 2018, partly from pre-existing toll roads; federal cost accounting was done for the Interstate System as a whole, not route by route.
why.zh: 无公开数据。本路线由 15 个州与哥伦比亚特区自 1950 年代至 2018 年分段建成，部分路段由既有收费公路改造而来；联邦造价核算针对整个州际公路系统，并未逐条统计。

why.en: Traffic counts are published per segment by each state DOT, and they vary by more than an order of magnitude along this route — from urban New Jersey and Connecticut down to rural northern Maine. A single route-wide number would be meaningless, and no agency publishes one.
why.zh: 交通量由各州交通部门按路段发布，而本路线沿途差异超过一个数量级——从新泽西、康涅狄格的城市段到缅因州北部的乡村段。单一的全线数字没有意义，也没有任何机构发布过。

timeline.en: I-95 is assigned in the first numbering of the Interstate System.
timeline.zh: 州际公路系统首次编号，I-95 获得编号。

timeline.en: Maine completes the Bangor–Houlton section, carrying the route to the Canadian border.
timeline.zh: 缅因州建成班戈至霍尔顿路段，本路线抵达加拿大边境。

timeline.en: New Jersey cancels the Somerset Freeway, leaving a permanent gap in the route.
timeline.zh: 新泽西州取消萨默塞特高速公路计划，本路线出现长期缺口。

timeline.en: The Pennsylvania Turnpike interchange opens at Bristol Township, closing the last gap after 61 years.
timeline.zh: 布里斯托尔镇的宾州收费高速互通立交通车，六十一年后补上最后一处缺口。
